name: auto-visio-helper
description: Plan, generate, reproduce, and refine editable Microsoft Visio scientific diagrams. Converts natural-language method descriptions, paper screenshots, PPT screenshots, or hand-drawn sketches into a reviewable JSON drawing spec, then renders it into an editable .vsdx via local Visio COM automation. Supports model architecture, workflow, system architecture, experiment, pseudo-code, sequence, and module-interaction diagrams. Requires Windows + a licensed local Microsoft Visio install.
